Container.Name: PelicanTrayGenerator
Container.Overview:
Designs 3D-printable stackable trays that fill a Pelican case cutout. Upload SVG part outlines, enter the cutout size and per-part depths, and it packs the parts onto trays snapped to a 25 mm grid, stacks them in the case, previews the result in 3D and exports 3MF and STL.
Everything runs in the browser. The container is a static web server, holds no state and needs no volumes; projects are saved as .json files by the browser.
